content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

Section 8.2–8.3 (¶p0035–p0036) is the document's only renewal mechanic, and it already sits at our preferred position:

- **12-month renewal terms** — "renews for successive twelve-month periods" (no multi-year renewal, so no walk-away risk).
- **30-day opt-out** — Customer non-renewal notice is thirty days, inside both the 30-day preferred and 60-day fallback windows.
- **60-day Vendor reminder** — expressly required, and failure to send it tolls Customer's opt-out deadline (an extra Customer protection).
- **Uplift capped at lesser of CPI and 3%** — plus ninety days' notice of any increase and no increase on prepaid periods.

All five preferred elements are met verbatim on the face of the clause, so no upgrade or redline is warranted.
